findings.summary: system-store CurrentUser does NOT trust the presented chain (90 anchors)

fix.caveat: Windows asks for confirmation in a dialog before it adds a root to this account's store, and services running as other accounts do not read it - the LocalMachine command reaches them too

findings.summary: system-store LocalMachine does NOT trust the presented chain (90 anchors)

fix.elevation: the LocalMachine store is read by every account and every service on this machine, so changing it needs administrator rights
fix.caveat: programs that carry a store of their own - git and java among them - do not read this one, so their rows need their own commands

notes.detail: certdoctor does not detect containers yet, so this is left empty rather than answered no
diagnosis from inside a container is not built yet, so this report covers the machine it ran on and nothing else - to look inside a container, run certdoctor there
this schema is still moving and will keep moving until certdoctor reaches 1.0.0 - pin this version only if you are prepared to update, and read CHANGELOG.md before you do

the trust matrix asks only the runtimes this build has probes for (system-store, git, java, curl, node, python, pip) - the other families are not asked yet, so an absent runtime here means nobody looked rather than nothing was found
